article.headline: 76ers visit Pacers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Philadelphia 76ers (15-4, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (6-12, 12th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: 76ers visit Pacers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: 76ers visit Pacers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Philadelphia 76ers (15-4, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (6-12, 12th in the Eastern Conference) Indianapolis; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST LINE: 76ers -4.5; over/under is 234.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Philadelphia 76ers travel to face the Philadelphia 76ers in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Pacers are 3-8 in conference matchups. Indiana is fifth in the Eastern Conference with 27.7 assists per game led by Andrew Nembhard averaging 7.6. The 76ers are 15-3 against Eastern Conference opponents. Philadelphia is ninth in the Eastern Conference scoring 46.3 points per game in the paint led by Tyrese Maxey averaging 10.0. The Pacers average 11.7 made 3-pointers per game this season, 1.1 fewer makes per game than the 76ers allow (12.8). The 76ers are shooting 46.7% from the field, 0.7% higher than the 46.0% the Pacers' opponents have shot this season. The teams play for the third time this season. The 76ers won the last meeting 131-124 on Nov. 15, with Jaylen Brown scoring 31 points in the win. TOP PERFORMERS: Pascal Siakam is averaging 22.9 points, 6.2 rebounds and 3.7 assists for the Pacers. Kelly Oubre Jr. is averaging 13.1 points over the last 10 games. Maxey is averaging 25.9 points and 5.7 assists for the 76ers. Brown is averaging 16.8 points over the past 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Pacers: 4-6, averaging 112.9 points, 43.5 rebounds, 28.1 assists, 7.1 steals and 4.9 blocks per game while shooting 47.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.8 points per game. 76ers: 7-3, averaging 118.7 points, 42.2 rebounds, 27.2 assists, 7.1 steals and 4.0 blocks per game while shooting 48.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 119.9 points. INJURIES: Pacers: Larry Nance Jr.: day to day (ankle), Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Aaron Nesmith: day to day (foot), Johnny Furphy: out (knee), T.J. McConnell: day to day (hamstring). 76ers: Ariel Hukporti: out for season (achilles), Jaylen Brown: day to day (hamstring), Joel Embiid: day to day (illness). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
